name: 염라
quote: 생과 사의 경계는 이미 정해져 있다.
outfit: 화려한 금색 자수가 놓인 검은색 관복
gloves: 금색 장식이 된 검은 비단 장갑
silhouette: 머리의 면류관, 손에 든 긴 홀, 등 뒤의 거대한 원형 업경, 몸 주변을 떠다니는 빛의 입자
signature_motion: 홀을 땅에 내리치며 주변에 붉은 파동을 일으킴
signature_vfx: 업경에서 뿜어져 나오는 붉은색 안개와 황금빛 불꽃
visual_en: A small-scale 2-head tall deity wearing a black and gold traditional Korean crown (Myeonryugwan) with bright red beads. The character has pale white skin and piercing golden eyes. He wears a heavy black royal robe adorned with intricate gold dragon embroidery and a flowing golden aura around his head. Behind his back, a massive, circular, glowing mirror (Upgyeong) floats, reflecting a divine light. He holds a long, golden ceremonial scepter (Hall) topped with a brilliant jewel. As his health drops, his entire body and the floating mirror glow with a saturated, menacing crimson red, and intense dark purple flames flicker around his feet.
features_en: A large plain round bronze mirror with a smooth undecorated rim and no writing
pose_en: Standing upright with immense authority, clutching a golden scepter.
vfx_en: Crimson flames rising from the ground at its feet and a few golden embers
motion_en: Stamping the ground to summon underworld minions
lore: 저승길 스테이지 보스. 가장 넓은 장판을 깔고 졸개를 쉼 없이 부른다. 체력 절반부터 업경을 띄우고 붉게 바뀐다(네페르 틀 + s1).
stages: 체력이 절반 아래로 깎인 모습 — 뒤에 둥근 업경(거울)을 띄우고 온몸이 붉게 달아오른다

anim_notes.attack: raising its scepter and slamming a wide glowing judgment circle onto the ground
anim_notes.ultimate: summoning many small spirits while the mirror behind it glows

concept: 저승길 — 한국 저승 설화(저승차사 · 옥졸 · 삼도천 · 명부 · 염라). 무섭되 이 게임의 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

body_plan.body: A humanoid character wearing a black and gold ornate robe and a matching hat, surrounded by a flame-like aura.
